title: ToolZoneX
description: A platform of 100+ free online calculators and AI utilities for finance, health, and everyday decisions.
longDescription: Built for India and designed to be fast: 100+ calculators covering income tax, EMI, SIP, PPF, GST, BMI and more. Next.js 15 with the App Router, TypeScript for type-safe calculator logic, and static site generation so every page is pre-rendered at build time.

title: SAM-3 Professional Annotation Tool
description: Production-grade refactor of Meta's Segment Anything Model 3 for rapid, high-fidelity data labeling.
longDescription: Turns Meta's SAM 3 into a tool a labeling team can actually use day to day — a professional annotation UI, COCO-format export for VLA model training, and workflows optimized for speed on large datasets.

title: Aura Email Assistant
description: AI-powered email assistant that fetches unread Outlook mail and drafts intelligent responses.
longDescription: Connects to Outlook, reads unread messages, and generates context-aware draft replies with modern LLMs — cutting the time spent on inbox management without ever sending anything on your behalf.

title: Artificial-Intelligence-A2Z
description: A structured Jupyter-based curriculum for learning AI, ML, and computer vision from scratch.
longDescription: A progressive set of notebooks that takes a learner from fundamentals through machine learning and computer vision, designed so each concept is runnable and builds on the one before it.

title: TrialTreat
description: Two-sided marketplace connecting beauty academies and trainees with consumers seeking affordable services.
longDescription: A full-stack marketplace matching beauty academies and their trainees with customers looking for lower-cost services — built with React on the front end, Node.js services, and PostgreSQL for persistence.

title: MachineLearningProjects
description: Central repository for machine learning experiments, models, and notebooks.
longDescription: A growing collection of ML work kept in one place — experiments, trained models, and the notebooks behind them, so results stay reproducible instead of scattered across one-off files.

title: Lilhakr Browser
description: A custom desktop web browser built with Python, PyQt6, and PyWebEngine.
longDescription: A side project exploring what goes into a desktop browser — window and tab management, navigation, and rendering through PyWebEngine, wrapped in a PyQt6 interface.

title: Supercool Scripts
description: A collection of standalone Python and Jupyter scripts that automate everyday tasks.
longDescription: Small, self-contained automation scripts that each solve one recurring annoyance — the kind of tooling that quietly saves an hour a week once it exists.
